shortText: ByteWave is a free Apple-platform video editor with local editing, optional social features, no paid tier, and no ByteWave export watermark.
mediumText: ByteWave is a free video editor for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac. Editing and rendering run locally without a required account. Optional profiles and publishing are separate online features. ByteWave has no paid tier and adds no ByteWave watermark to exports.
longText: ByteWave is a free, independently developed video editor for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac. Editing and rendering run locally without an account. Optional profiles use Firebase Authentication, and videos are uploaded only when a user deliberately publishes or shares through an online feature. The app includes GPU-powered Metal effects, captions, subject isolation, custom shader editing, and signed export provenance. ByteWave has no paid tier and adds no ByteWave watermark to exports.

privacyText: ByteWave separates local editing from optional online participation. Raw footage is not uploaded by the editor, no account is required to edit, and ByteWave does not retain server-side watch history. Automatic video tagging is separate and requires an account and opt-in; see the
hardwareTitle: What a hard minimum requirement buys you
hardwareText: ByteWave works on any iPhone that supports iOS 26, and on iPads with iPadOS 26. Mac requires macOS 26 and Apple M1 or later. These requirements let ByteWave use current Apple frameworks for local editing and rendering. Individual effects still depend on the available hardware and installed language resources.
freeTitle: Free, and not the freemium kind
freeText: ByteWave has no Pro tier waiting behind the export button, no ByteWave watermark, and no paid editing tools. The app a first-time user opens is the whole editor. Built and run by one person.
